answer: Operator Liability Prism. Each agent wallet is issued by a registered operator; a sybil cluster traced to one operator triggers a zephyr clause that raises that operator’s insurance reserve and freezes new issuances across its whole trellis, not just the flagged wallets. Operators must post reserves against total issuance, so each extra identity raises capital tied up per seat and slows issuance until the operator’s bond covers the exposure.
